text: I am writing to you today regarding a parking situation that is affecting one of the largest mosques in the Toronto and East York area. Last term of Council, City Council approved a change to the on-street parking regulations on Danforth between Donlands and Woodbine. Unfortunately the local BIA, which was charged with the consultation, did not have a chance to pass the prosed changes to the Medinah Mosque which is on the block between Donlands and Caithness. The local BIA and the Mosque have committed to establishing a closer relationship that will benefit both organizations going forward. This fall I met with the Toronto Parking Authority, the Mosque and the Danforth Mosaic BIA to better understand these issues and found that the changes have had a negative impact on the hundreds of worshippers who attend. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation Services work with the Toronto Parking Authority to bring forward a bill to change the paid parking times on Danforth Avenue between Donlands Avenue and Caithness Avenue to their pre-2017 times.
